title: Netweb Technologies India Ltd - 543945 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue INR8,197m (+172% YoY) and PAT margin 10.3%, but inventory days jumped 86→110 and management declined to guide new capex, with a possible enabling resolution for working-capital equity or debt.

summary.headline: Netweb Q1 FY27 revenue rose 172.1% YoY to INR8,197 million with PAT of INR853 million (10.3% margin), driven by the AI segment at 62% of revenue.
summary.overview:
Netweb reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue and profit, with revenue from operations of INR8,197 million (+172.1% YoY) and PAT of INR853 million (+179.9% YoY). Operating EBITDA was INR1,205 million at a 14.7% margin. The AI segment contributed INR5,106 million (62% of revenue, +484% YoY), while HPC and Private Cloud contributed INR1,253 million and INR1,353 million. Working capital moved up: inventory days rose from 86 to 110 as the company built raw-material stock against memory and component shortages, while receivable days fell from 86 to 78; net debt was INR1,999 million.</overview>

segments.name: AI systems
segments.commentary: INR5,105.7 million, 62% of Q1 revenue, growing 484% YoY; management expects AI to be roughly 40-45% of the order book.

segments.name: HPC
segments.commentary: INR1,252.94 million in Q1; management says the three pillars (AI, HPC, Private Cloud) are all growing and intact.

segments.name: Private Cloud / HCI
segments.commentary: INR1,353.46 million in Q1; Tyrone Skylus indigenous private cloud platform targets data localisation and sovereignty needs.

guidance_outlook: Order book INR25,069 million as of 30 June 2026, plus L1 of INR8,480 million; management cites about INR3,400 crore combined and a pipeline of about INR104,100 million (INR10,401 crore) that now includes strategic orders.
Management guides about 60% pipeline conversion over 18-24 months; the earlier 18-month timeline now stretches to 18-24 months.
Execution cycle now guided at 16-20 weeks versus 8-12 weeks earlier, and may stretch or come early.
Margins guided at 13-14%; management says Q1's 14.7% EBITDA margin is within this range and will remain similar.
Management said it does not see memory prices softening for the next couple of quarters, perhaps a year.
Management says the order book and pipeline support about two years of revenue; a call on how the year splits by half was deferred.
